+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML records in stderr, preserving all other bytes."""
+    header = b"#< CLIXML\r\n"
+    bare_header = b"CLIXML\r\n"
+    if bare_header not in stderr:
+        return stderr
+
+    # Keep byte offsets so that text before and after each record (including
+    # text on the same line as a record) can be copied without re-encoding it.
+    headers: list[int] = []
+    offset = 0
+    for line in stderr.splitlines(keepends=True):
+        header_index = line.find(header)
+        if header_index != -1:
+            headers.append(offset + header_index)
+        elif line.startswith(bare_header) and (offset == 0 or stderr[offset - 2:offset] == b"\r\n"):
+            headers.append(offset)
+        offset += len(line)
+
+    if not headers:
+        return stderr
+
+    output = bytearray()
+    cursor = 0
+    for start in headers:
+        if start < cursor:
+            continue
+
+        position = start + (len(header) if stderr.startswith(header, start) else len(bare_header))
+        # PowerShell can emit several headers before the XML starts.
+        while True:
+            while position < len(stderr) and stderr[position] in b" \t\r\n":
+                position += 1
+            if stderr.startswith(header, position):
+                position += len(header)
+            elif stderr.startswith(bare_header, position):
+                position += len(bare_header)
+            else:
+                break
+
+        if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", position):
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", position)
+        if end == -1:
+            continue
+        end += len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        # A single CLIXML header can be followed by several XML roots.
+        while True:
+            next_start = end
+            while next_start < len(stderr) and stderr[next_start] in b" \t\r\n":
+                next_start += 1
+            if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", next_start):
+                break
+            next_end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", next_start)
+            if next_end == -1:
+                break
+            end = next_end + len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        original = stderr[start:end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                clixml = original.decode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                clixml = original.decode("cp437")
+            decoded = _parse_clixml(clixml.encode("utf-8"))
+        except (ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
+            continue
+
+        output.extend(stderr[cursor:start])
+        output.extend(decoded)
+        cursor = end
+
+    if cursor == 0:
+        return stderr
+    output.extend(stderr[cursor:])
+    return bytes(output)
+
